gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away

definitions.gloss: to wipe off; to wipe away
definitions.explanation: To remove liquid, dirt, or something unwanted by wiping with a cloth or hand.
Figuratively, to eliminate or remove something negative like doubts or suspicions.

examples.japanese: タオルで{汗|あせ}を{拭|ぬぐ}った。
examples.english: I wiped off the sweat with a towel.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}を{拭|ぬぐ}って{笑顔|えがお}を{見|み}せた。
examples.english: She wiped away her tears and showed a smile.

examples.japanese: {不安|ふあん}を{拭|ぬぐ}い{去|さ}ることができない。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: Xを{拭|ぬぐ}う

ASPECT (ている):
{拭|ぬぐ}っている - is wiping (action in progress)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{汗|あせ}を{拭|ぬぐ}う - to wipe off sweat
・{涙|なみだ}を{拭|ぬぐ}う - to wipe away tears
・{口|くち}を{拭|ぬぐ}う - to wipe one's mouth

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
・{不安|ふあん}を{拭|ぬぐ}う - to dispel anxiety
・{疑惑|ぎわく}を{拭|ぬぐ}う - to clear away suspicions
・{汚名|おめい}を{拭|ぬぐ}う - to clear one's name

RELATED:
・{拭|ふ}く - to wipe (more common, everyday)
・{拭|ぬぐ}い{去|さ}る - to wipe away completely

NOTE:
{拭|ぬぐ}う is slightly more literary/formal than {拭|ふ}く.
